# Shed Building Permit

> Shed Building Permit (part of GetMyPermit) prepares and lodges building permit applications for sheds, garages and outbuildings in Perth and Western Australia.

## Pages

- [Shed building permits in Perth, done for you.](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/): Need a shed building permit in Perth or WA? We check your council's rules, draw the site plan and lodge your application. Fixed price, no runaround.
- [Do I need a permit for a shed in WA?](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/do-i-need-a-permit-for-a-shed): In WA a freestanding shed of 10 m² or less and 2.4 m tall or less usually doesn't need a building permit. Here is how to measure, and the rules that still apply.
- [Garage building permits in WA](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/garage-building-permit): Every garage in WA needs a building permit, and many need planning approval too. What triggers it, how garages differ from carports and sheds, and how we handle it.
- [Retrospective shed approval in WA](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/retrospective-shed-approval): Shed built without a permit? How retrospective approval works in WA, what the surveyor checks, common problems with older sheds, and how we handle it for you.
- [Shed size checker: permit or no permit?](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/shed-size-checker): Free WA shed size checker. Enter length, width, height and lot size to see if your shed needs a building permit or planning approval, and the setback from the fence.
- [How close can a shed be to the fence in WA?](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/how-close-can-a-shed-be-to-the-fence): Under WA's standard rules a shed wall up to 9 m long sits 1 m from a side or rear fence. When it can go closer or on the boundary, and what needs planning approval.
- [Guides](https://shedbuildingpermit.com.au/guides): Free tools and plain-English guides to sheds and garages approvals in Perth and Western Australia, checked against the official rules.
